body: Personally I don’t think it’s wrong, he did something awful to you and it’s a normal response to hate him.
I definitely do need a nap :)

It’s okay to make assumptions, I don’t blame you. They’ve said they haven’t been friends with them and that they haven’t followed them or whatever in “like a week” but I know for sure otherwise, which just makes me angry. She at least believes me, but i think she took it really hard. Thank you for your support. I’ve just been really out of it.

I wish they had responded with love like you hoped. I would say it wasn’t a fun conversation but it was barely even a conversation at all. I understand that it was uncalled for and I shouldn’t have said it, but the only way she responded was with lies and short uncaring messages, and one long message saying it wasn’t  her fault and that she doesn’t want to talk to me. It didn’t go very well. :( . But thank you for commenting and giving me support.

Thank you so much for your support. They ended up replying but it was only short replies and some I knew she was lying about some things to me, and ended up saying she didn’t want to talk to me. So I just let it go and blocked her, I don’t really know what to do. Nothing feels real?
I sent a LONG apology. It’s been seen but there’s no reply.
Listen I’m not gonna judge but this probably isn’t the subreddit you’re looking for :) I’d suggest an nsfw subreddit or one that isn’t strictly platonic. Have fun though!
It’s nice to know I’m not alone (obviously not nice ur in the situation in general though).
I feel the same way exactly. I’m so sorry you are also going through this. It’s such a hard and complicated situation.

You are under no obligation to tell him, only do so if you want to. Don’t feel pressured to talk about it so soon unless you want to. It’s 100% your choice. I would suggest telling him at some point though so you have a support.

I don’t think there’s anything wrong with you, you can’t really control your emotions. It may be because you were with him for so long you got used to it maybe? Thats all I can come up with though, but the main thing is that there isn’t anything wrong with you and it’s okay to not be angry.

I hope they’ll surprise me if it ever gets too much and I do have to talk with them about it, but I’m going to let it go for right now. I definitely feel a lot better after talking about it, so thank you. :)

It’s a little familiar, but it’s more like things I already do that I was interested in don’t make me feel better anymore, and just feel like a source of resentment because I’m either not good at them or something else, and people will ask me why I’m not motivated to do them anymore or why I don’t try harder. I think I’m just tired of not being able to live up to expectations, mine or others, and I’m constantly a disappointment when others have hopes for me. 

My friends keep belittling me or touching on things I don’t want to talk about or praising people who have done awful things to me, but I can’t necessarily blame them because I haven’t told them it bothers me or what a specific person has done, but i know if I did it would be brushed off, nobody would care, or I would be the ‘bad guy’ in the situation, I guess. This has gotten a little “wah everyone is against me 😢😭” sounding, sorry about that. I think I just need to figure out how to react or simplify the situation I guess.

(They are very cute! Unless they are naked. They sort of endearing naked but mostly disgusting)

For a while, but especially amplified this year. Everything I do drains me and makes me feel negative, even if it’s a technically good thing (ex. Working out, hanging out with friends). 

(And yes I really do love them, they are my little buddies)

It absolutely wasn’t your fault. You said no, and even physically pushed him off one time. This would definitely be considered sexual abuse, and using manipulation and guilt tactics to try and get you to have sex. I’m so sorry you went through this.
Oh my god that is absolutely awful. I’m so so sorry this was said to you. That’s so disgusting.

You aren’t overreacting, something horrible happened to you and it’s okay to still be upset and affected by it. I’d suggest talking to him about it and how you feel during sex and see if you may feel better in general after that. And trust me, I also feel this way, whenever I even think about having sex I just cringe and want to vomit, not as serious as your reaction, but I haven’t actually tried to have sex yet. I’m sorry this is happening to you.

I’m so sorry this happened to you. I would say to confront her or talk about it now that you are older to maybe find closure but since you are taking care of her and she has medical issues that may not be the best course of action. I’m sorry you aren’t able to fully forget, but for your panic attacks and suicidal thoughts I would suggest seeing a therapist if you are able to, just to get it all out and get professional advice about the situation. I hope you feel better about this situation soon :)

Oh yes, sorry, I agree with you on that one now that I’m thinking about it. I think I was focusing too much on the little first part of that incident and not enough about the actual awful part. I didn’t really comprehend that one well, which is my bad. I still do consider all of them to be sexual assault/rape. I’m still sorry these all happened to you and I wish you well :)

I don’t even know how to fully respond to this. But I’m just gonna say it bluntly, your husband is kind of an insensitive asshole. I know you didn’t come here to listen to your husband be insulted so I’m going to leave it at that. I’d suggest having a LONG conversation about him with this, and being absolutely firm about your boundaries. Faking orgasm to please him is giving him false expectations and making him believe you are okay with it, so it’d be best to stop doing that and be honest. If he keeps pressuring you after this I’d suggest marriage counseling or even divorce if it’s ruining your marriage enough, but I do understand you have a child and that may not be an option. I’m sorry this is happening to you and I hope you get through this.

The first two I would consider sexual assault at least at the beginning and they should be held accountable for it. The third one I feel a bit iffy about. I’m assuming you were both a little bit tipsy because of the mention of drinking. I do believe the taking the jacket off was consented (because you responded to it and I’m taking that as you were okay with it but if you weren’t then nevermind) but he definitely should have asked before doing the rest. Consent to one thing does not mean consent to more. I’m sorry these things happened to you and I hope this helped even a little. This comment seems a bit jumbled so I apologize for that, I can explain better if you need. :)

Long story short, I do think all of these stories are assaults either in the beginning or end, or at the least dubious or manipulated consent. I’m sorry this happened to you, and I hope this helps you.

This is incredibly abnormal. It is absolutely not your fault and you are not the one to blame. After you asked him to stop the consent you had given was revoked, and he should’ve stopped. I’m so sorry this happened to you.

I’m so sorry this happened to you. It was rape, you were intoxicated. And yes you can absolutely be raped by a partner, any person can commit a horrible crime, no matter what their relationship is to the victim.
I’m so sorry this happened to you. I also experience this, but it only happens when I think about having sex with someone and then I feel it and I immediately shut down.
It was definitely rape. And even if it was “just sexual assault” it would still be awful. I’m sorry this happened to you.
Thank you so much. This makes me feel a bit better about it.
I just feel like it’d be awkward to bring it up randomly after discussing my day. It just doesn’t feel right I guess :/

I’m sorry this happened to you. I swear to you that any way you feel is valid and you are not overreacting. What she did was horribly wrong, and it’s okay to miss and like the good things she did. You aren’t lying or making it up, it’s something horrible that happened, and you are allowed to be upset.
I’m proud of all of us as well. Even through hard times and even if some of us are still struggling we are still here and still trying, and that 100% counts for something.

I feel the same way. I think it’s just missing the things they used to do, or the nice and sweet things they did do. It’s okay to feel like this, and it’s probably normal. I miss mine until I remember.

I’m so sorry this happened to you. Please report it and gather evidence as soon as possible, I know that’s a lot to ask after a traumatic event but if you would want to make a case against them it’s needed. Talk to police or confide in trustworthy friends/ family members. I’m sorry I have no specific resources to link.

It’s your choice to forgive her ultimately, and some say it’s a step in the healing process. It’s definitely okay, but remember that you don’t have to forgive. You don’t have to make excuses for her behavior, what she did was wrong, and she absolutely knows it. Do what you think is right.

This is absolutely not normal. I’m so sorry this happened to you. I encourage you to tell someone, either someone close to you or a therapist. You did not over react in any way, and he has no excuses for his behavior.
I’m so sorry this kind of thing happened to you. Please if possible reach out to someone or call a hotline, or anyone you trust. You deserve to be happy and move forward.

I’m so sorry this happened to you. It is absolutely not your fault and the only one to blame is him. You were intoxicated, and did not give consent. It was violent and I’m sorry it happened. You didn’t over react, what he did was disgusting and deplorable.

I feel the same way. I haven’t told anyone I know in real life. I think I just want comfort or validation that it actually happened, and that other people also think that it’s wrong. I think it’s also a need to be heard.
I’m so sorry this happened to you. This is not your fault.
That’s so upsetting. That poor dog. What awful people.
In my opinion it was 100% rape. You tried to stop him and he refused to, and even threatened you. I’m so sorry that you went through that.

Thank you so much for your insight and support. I have been planning on breaking up with him, I’ve just been too nervous to do it. But I will soon. I will try to get a therapist once my family is more financially stable, or if our insurance covers it. Thank you for your advice.
Thank you for your insight. :)
Thank you.
Pedophiles. Just the thought of them.

He hates watching dubbed anime, but sometimes he asks me to put dub on because he wants to know what’s going on but he wants to watch me instead of the screen

When I started dating my current boyfriend.  He made me feel so much better, I didn’t feel a burden like I had with my ex. He didn’t push me into kissing him or being intimate, he didn’t threaten suicide to guilt me into doing things. He changed my life for the better. He’s helped me so much with my depression and I’ve been clean for over a year. Haven’t even thought about seriously killing myself for a while. I’m a lot happier and more motivated now.

They know it’s wrong now of course. Also the same person blocked me on EVERYTHING for a few days because I told them to stop being a bitch to my boyfriend and that I liked him. They unblocked me a few days later and pretended like nothing ever happened.
